prompt: Compose an original complete 60-second instrumental cue for warm human-centered product story. Instruments: electric piano, muted brass, electric bass, snare. 100 BPM in 4/4. Motif: a rising fourth followed by a descending step. Start the hook and beat immediately; maintain a clear pulse and concise two-bar phrases. One fresh timbral answer halfway through. Keep the groove throughout, then a decisive tonic ending during the last second with a very short natural decay. No slow intro, long outro, riser, silence or fade-out. Mobile-speaker-friendly bass. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: An upbeat and positive orchestral pop track featuring a prominent piano melody, supported by strings, brass, and a driving rhythm section. It has a bright and cheerful atmosphere.
